name: point-and-speak
description: Point with the mouse while you talk (built-in /voice) or type. The mod adds where the pointer was, what was under it, and a small annotated screenshot to your prompt, then deletes the files after the answer.

uvPath.title: uv executable
uvPath.description: Path to uv, which runs the helper with its dependencies.

onlyWithPointingWords.title: Only when you say this, that, here or circled
onlyWithPointingWords.description: Add pointer context only to prompts that contain a pointing word. Turn this off to add it to every prompt.

screenshots.title: Take screenshots
screenshots.description: Add an annotated screenshot and crops to the context. Turn this off to send only the spoken text, the pointer positions and the names of the controls under the pointer.
